day_shape: 91 items: US Treasury moves to sever Banque Misr UAE from dollar system and sanctions Bank Melli Dubai manager under Operation Economic Outcast, CENTCOM reports 82 vessels redirected under Iran blockade, IDF kills Hamas commander Bitawi in Jenin and Oct 7 participant Bass in Gaza, Khamenei issues Government Week message forbidding acts harming social cohesion; nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: US economic campaign targets Iran banking
threads.summary: The US Treasury proposed revoking Banque Misr UAE's correspondent banking access over alleged Iran dealings, and the State Department sanctioned Reza Mohammad Taeedi, manager of Bank Melli's Dubai branch, under Operation Economic Outcast. Iran International reported Iranian banks continue operating in the UAE despite the campaign, and cited Kpler data showing Iran's crude exports near zero under the maritime blockade.

threads.label: CENTCOM blockade and Hormuz claims
threads.summary: CENTCOM said that as of 28 August its forces have redirected 82 commercial vessels, disabled 3 and boarded 2 enforcing the US blockade against Iran. IRIB cited an IMO figure of over 400 ships awaiting passage in the Strait of Hormuz, and IRGC Navy claimed via Defa Press that the strait is closed to uncoordinated passage.

threads.label: Khamenei Government Week message
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released the Supreme Leader's Government Week message declaring acts harming social cohesion forbidden and rejecting false dichotomies between war and negotiation. The message commended the fourteenth government under intensified sanctions and demanded attention to inflation, unemployment and commodity markets, drawing endorsements from the Judiciary head and Basij.

threads.label: Iranian leadership defiance messaging
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian said at national project openings that Iran does not welcome war but will stand against any aggressor, echoed by IRGC and Army commanders claiming the enemy failed to achieve strategic objectives in the 12-day war. Foreign Minister Araghchi accused US and Israeli-aligned actors of manipulating energy markets, while Vice President Makhber said Iran turns blockade into blockader's failure.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Gaza and Jenin
threads.summary: The IDF said a drone strike in Jenin killed three operatives including Qais Bitawi, described by Shin Bet as head of Hamas activity in the Jenin refugee camp. Separate strikes in Gaza City's Shati and Sabra areas killed Hamas commander Ibrahim Nabil Bass, an October 7 participant, and Islamic Jihad platoon commander Hamdi Kahlil.

threads.label: Iranian domestic economy strain
threads.summary: Iran International reported Iranians selling burial plots to cover living costs and evidence of organised fuel diversion beyond border smuggling. State outlets countered with claims of a 200,000-barrel rise in daily oil production over two years and a 120,000-barrel capacity increase at NIOC South.

threads.label: Iran-linked cases and diplomatic positioning
threads.summary: A British-Iranian man accused of offering to assist the IRGC Quds Force will stand trial in 2027 after an undercover operation involving a bag he believed contained a drone. Iran International reported Mohsen Rezaei setting four conditions for a US deal, and the Jerusalem Post noted Iranian interest in the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement.
